**Judgment-day confirmed CRITICAL: reviewer priorVerdicts always empty**

What: judgment-day (2 blind judges jd-judge-a + jd-judge-b, both opus) on the reviewer subsystem CONFIRMED (both agree) a CRITICAL + several real warnings. NOTE: user's real goal was mechanism COMPARISON (judgment-day vs brain-reviewer), not judging the reviewer — but the run produced valuable confirmed defects.
CONFIRMED CRITICAL: in production vcs.prReviews returns {state,author} with NO body (github.mjs ~291; gitlab.mjs ~277 reads APPROVALS api not MR notes). parse-verdict.mjs:36 needs a string body -> returns null -> cold-boot doctrine.priorVerdicts is ALWAYS [] in prod. Consequence: anti-loop lock (poster.mjs:72) dead (re-posts duplicate verdict every rerun), rev>=3->STOP bound (verdict.mjs:58) dead (infinite REVISE), §8 prior-verdict doctrine load dead, board reconciliation dead. Tests are green ONLY because fixtures inject a body the real adapters never emit (cold-boot.mjs:79 comment admits it). GitLab doubly broken: verdicts are notes but prReviews returns approvals.
CONFIRMED WARNING(real): refuter + schema-v2 + causal downgrade (#284) are DEAD CODE — cli.mjs buildVerdict never passes protocol, defaults brain-review/1; only own tests import evaluateRefuter/validateSchemaV2; doctrine §13 (asserts /2 'strictly') contradicts the tree. Findings don't round-trip (render YAML list vs parse JSON scalar). Self-review abstention inactive in default config (reviewer.handle:"").
CONFIRMED positive: security boundary SOUND — no APPROVE path, COMMENT-only hardcoded, deny-set fail-closed on add+remove. 'never authorizes merge' holds.
SUSPECT (one judge): --pr NaN not validated (A7); --issue not parsed so ruling unreachable (B6); FORK-without-label reviewed as tranche (A9); priorRevCount counts all not REVISE (B5); verdict ordering assumes oldest-first no sort (B7); FENCE_RE first-block (B9); needs-decision non-atomic post (B10).
Terminal: JUDGMENT ESCALATED (confirmed CRITICAL, no fix applied yet). Fixes belong in M3 (reviewer). Scorecard premise #3 dropped 70%->45%; overall ~66%->~63%.
Docs: docs/inbox/reviewer-mechanisms-comparison.md, docs/inbox/brain-v2-merge-audit.md (§0-bis).
Related: [[architecture/reviewer-inline-comments]] [[architecture/v2-conformance-scorecard]] [[architecture/v2-epic-plan]].
